page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.se1ne family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, featuring 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance profile characterized by moderate multi-threaded capabilities and weaker single-core execution. The single-core performance is positioned in the bottom 25% tier, as demonstrated by a stress-ng single-core score of 1108.98 and a Geekbench single-core score of 935.0. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, such as the stress-ng multi-core test (17660.86) and Geekbench multi-core test (7163.0), fall within the average range. Memory bandwidth is stable, with uncached read speeds at 96.89 GB/sec and write speeds at 52.55 GB/sec, both ranking in the middle tier.

Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-heavy workloads that do not require extreme single-thread processing speeds. It is appropriate for database operations, caching layers like Redis (which achieved 16.8 million operations per second in testing), software compilation, and moderate multi-threaded data processing. However, the lack of local storage and lower single-threaded performance make it less optimal for disk-intensive tasks or latency-sensitive single-core applications.
